about: Model tests (docs/12). Each case is one request. expect: the tools a good answer uses (plugin.tool, a plugin name for any of its tools, or a core tool); [] = no tool should run; left out = not scored. may_fail: a failed tool only warns (needs a sign-in or the network). chat: cases with the same chat name share one chat, in order. The smoke test's ten requests are built in (src/eval.rs). Keep cases free of lasting changes: no memory writes, no calendar edits, no music playing; reminders and alarms are cancelled after the run.

cases.text: Will it rain in Vancouver tomorrow?
